wholePhysicalScope: OSM way 23504437 version 7 and all twelve contemporaneous node positions establish the museum perimeter in January 2016. The Gothic street range and entrance face east along Rolleston Avenue.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the Gothic frontage, square roof tower, porch, rose window and connected rear ranges. Closer levels refine the arches, tracery and masonry detail.
limitations: January 2016 exterior before redevelopment. Roof dimensions, concealed portions of the tower, secondary elevations and the later gallery roofs are estimates.
The temporary exhibition banner and street furnishings are outside this architectural scope.
The original elevation field is preserved. Local floor and threshold levels are representative.
